### A Prayer for Peace in Relationships
Author: Victoria Riollano
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-for-peace-in-relationships.html
Passage: Romans 12:18
Points:
- Experiencing betrayal, gossip, and hurt tests the command to live at peace with everyone.
- Biblical peace requires choosing forgiveness and actively cultivating harmony rather than settling for cold politeness.
- Jesus provided the ultimate pattern of forgiveness by praying for those who mistreated and crucified Him.
- Taking intentional initiative toward reconciliation frees believers from the burden of bitterness, even if their efforts are not received.

### Overcoming Evil with Good
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/overcoming-evil-good
Passage: Romans 12:21
Points:
- Believers are called not simply to endure mistreatment passively, but to take the initiative to love and serve enemies.
- Refusing to repay evil protects Christians from becoming corrupted by worldly patterns of retaliation.
- Responding to hostility with kindness can disarm opposition and may lead adversaries to repentance.
- Showing selfless love to those who oppose us displays Christ's character and relies entirely on the Holy Spirit's power.
